subject: science
domain: Waves and Their Applications in Technologies for Information Transfer

items.prompt:
Sound is made when something
A) vibrates
B) sits still
C) is cold
D) is dark

To vibrate means to
A) move back and forth very fast
B) stay still
C) get warm
D) glow
items.answer: A) move back and forth very fast

items.prompt:
If you hold a guitar string still, the sound
A) gets louder
B) stops
C) stays the same
D) turns into light

Rice on a drum jumps when a loud sound is made. This shows
A) sound can make things vibrate
B) rice is alive
C) drums make rice
D) sound is light
items.answer: A) sound can make things vibrate

steps: The sound makes the drum vibrate, moving the rice.

items.prompt:
When you hum, the buzzing you feel is your
A) throat vibrating
B) ears glowing
C) nose cooling
D) eyes moving

steps: Your throat vibrates to make the hum.

items.prompt:
A twanged ruler off a table edge
A) makes no sound
B) vibrates and makes a sound
C) turns into light
D) gets cold
items.answer: B) vibrates and makes a sound

steps: The vibrating ruler makes a sound.

items.prompt:
Which statement is correct?
A) Vibrating things make sound, and sound can make things vibrate
B) Sound has nothing to do with vibrations
C) Only still things make sound
D) Sound is made of light
items.answer: A) Vibrating things make sound, and sound can make things vibrate

steps: Both ideas are true: vibrations make sound, and sound makes vibrations.

items.prompt:
The BEST test to show sound makes something vibrate is to
A) look at a light
B) put rice on a drum and make a loud sound near it
C) weigh the drum
D) taste the rice
items.answer: B) put rice on a drum and make a loud sound near it

steps: The jumping rice shows the sound made the drum vibrate.
